fullPassage:
Let's Celebrate Marine Gardening Day!

A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact that there are forests in the sea, but the sea has forests, too. Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and numerous marine animals live there with them. That is, sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures and the leading contributors to creating a healthy marine ecosystem. However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants and the other creatures that live on them. So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world. It is meant to raise awareness of the seriousness of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests. Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. On a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash along the coast on this day. It is important to realize that small environmental activities we do can cause a big wave to preserve the sea.

questions.passage: A lot of people may be (A)[unfamiliar / familiar] with the fact that there are forests in the sea, but the sea has forests, too. Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and (B)[numerous / scarce] marine animals live there with them. That is, sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures and the leading (C)[contributors / obstacles] to creating a healthy marine ecosystem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 많은 사람들이 바다에 숲이 있다는 사실에 익숙하지 않다. 수많은 해양 동물이 살고, 해저 숲은 건강한 해양 생태계를 만드는 데 주요 기여자이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① unfamiliar — numerous — contributors
❌ ② familiar — scarce — obstacles
❌ ③ unfamiliar — scarce — contributors
❌ ④ familiar — numerous — obstacles
✅ (A) unfamiliar: 바다 숲에 대한 인식 부족. (B) numerous: 많은 해양 동물. (C) contributors: 생태계 기여자.
det.tip: unfamiliar(익숙하지 않은) ↔ familiar(익숙한). numerous(수많은) ↔ scarce(부족한). contributors(기여자) ↔ obstacles(장애물).

questions.passage: However, (A)[uncontrolled / regulated] human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants and the other creatures that live on them. So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day." It is meant to raise (B)[awareness / ignorance] of the seriousness of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests. Accordingly, many organizations (C)[contribute / refuse] to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 통제되지 않은 인간 활동이 위협. 인식을 높이기 위한 날. 많은 단체가 보호에 기여한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① regulated — ignorance — refuse
❌ ② regulated — awareness — refuse
✅ ③ uncontrolled — awareness — contribute
❌ ④ uncontrolled — ignorance — contribute
✅ (A) uncontrolled: 통제되지 않은 인간 활동. (B) awareness: 인식을 높이다. (C) contribute: 보호에 기여.
det.tip: uncontrolled(통제되지 않은) ↔ regulated(규제된). awareness(인식) ↔ ignorance(무지). contribute(기여하다) ↔ refuse(거부하다).

questions.passage: So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world. It is meant to raise awareness of the (A)[seriousness / insignificance] of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests. Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and (B)[reinforcing / weakening] the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. It is important to realize that small environmental activities we do can cause a big (C)[wave / barrier] to preserve the sea.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 해양 오염의 심각성에 대한 인식. 생태계를 강화하는 데 기여. 작은 활동이 큰 파도(변화)를 일으킬 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① seriousness — reinforcing — wave
❌ ② insignificance — weakening — barrier
❌ ③ seriousness — weakening — barrier
❌ ④ insignificance — reinforcing — wave
✅ (A) seriousness: 심각성. (B) reinforcing: 강화. (C) wave: 큰 파도(변화의 비유).
det.tip: seriousness(심각성) ↔ insignificance(하찮음). reinforcing(강화) ↔ weakening(약화). wave(파도, 변화) ↔ barrier(장벽).

questions.passage: A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact that there are forests in the sea, but the sea has forests, too. Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and numerous marine animals live there with them. That is, sea forests are ①<u>habitats</u> for underwater creatures and the leading ②<u>contributors</u> to creating a healthy marine ecosystem. However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have ③<u>protected</u> marine plants and the other creatures that live on them. So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as ④<u>"Marine Gardening Day."</u>
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ protected(보호했다) → threatened(위협했다). 원문: 통제되지 않은 인간 활동이 해양 식물을 위협했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①habitats: 원문 그대로. ✅ ②contributors: 원문 그대로. ❌ ③protected: 원문은 threatened. 위협이 문맥에 맞음. ✅ ④"Marine Gardening Day": 원문 그대로.
det.tip: threatened(위협했다) ↔ protected(보호했다). 인간 활동과 기후변화는 부정적 영향.

questions.passage: So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world. It is meant to raise awareness of the seriousness of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests. Accordingly, many organizations ①<u>contribute</u> to protecting and ②<u>reinforcing</u> the ecosystem in ③<u>damaged</u> ocean areas by planting marine plants. On a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash along the coast on this day. It is important to realize that small environmental activities we do can cause a big wave to ④<u>pollute</u> the sea.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ pollute(오염시키다) → preserve(보존하다). 원문: 작은 환경 활동이 바다를 보존하는 큰 파도를 일으킬 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①contribute: 원문 그대로. ✅ ②reinforcing: 원문 그대로. ✅ ③damaged: 원문 그대로. ❌ ④pollute: 원문은 preserve. 보존이 문맥에 맞음.
det.tip: preserve(보존하다) ↔ pollute(오염시키다). 환경 활동의 목적은 바다 보존.

questions.passage: A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact that there are forests in the sea. Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and numerous marine animals live there with them. However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants. So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day." It is meant to ①<u>raise</u> awareness of the ②<u>seriousness</u> of ocean pollution. Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by ③<u>planting</u> marine plants. It is important to realize that small environmental activities we do can cause a big wave to ④<u>neglect</u> the sea.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ neglect(방치하다) → preserve(보존하다). 원문: 작은 환경 활동이 바다를 보존하는 큰 변화를 일으킬 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①raise: 원문 그대로(인식을 높이다). ✅ ②seriousness: 원문 그대로(심각성). ✅ ③planting: 원문 그대로(식물 심기). ❌ ④neglect: 원문은 preserve. 방치가 아닌 보존이 목적.
det.tip: preserve(보존하다) ↔ neglect(방치하다). 글의 핵심 메시지: 작은 활동으로 바다를 지키자.

questions.passage: A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact that there are forests in the sea, but the sea has forests, too. Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and numerous marine animals live there with them. That is, sea forests are __________ for underwater creatures and the leading contributors to creating a healthy marine ecosystem. However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants and the other creatures that live on them.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 해저 숲은 수중 생물의 서식지이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③habitats: 서식지. 수중 생물이 사는 장소. ❌ ①barriers(장벽): 무관. ❌ ②threats(위협): 반대. ❌ ④obstacles(장애물): 무관.
det.tip: habitat: 서식지. 동식물이 자연적으로 살아가는 환경.

questions.passage: However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants and the other creatures that live on them. So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world. It is meant to raise __________ of the seriousness of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests. Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 해양 오염의 심각성에 대한 인식을 높이기 위한 것이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①awareness: 인식. raise awareness = 인식을 높이다. ❌ ②suspicion(의심): 무관. ❌ ③confusion(혼란): 무관. ❌ ④resistance(저항): 무관.
det.tip: raise awareness: 인식을 높이다. awareness of ~ = ~에 대한 인식.

questions.passage: So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world. It is meant to raise awareness of the seriousness of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests. Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the __________ in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. On a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash along the coast on this day. It is important to realize that small environmental activities we do can cause a big wave to preserve the sea.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 손상된 해양 지역의 생태계를 보호하고 강화하는 데 기여한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②ecosystem: 생태계. 보호하고 강화하는 대상. ❌ ①pollution(오염): 보호 대상이 아님. ❌ ③industry(산업): 무관. ❌ ④competition(경쟁): 무관.
det.tip: ecosystem: 생태계. marine ecosystem = 해양 생태계. 동식물이 상호작용하는 체계.

questions.passage: However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have <u>threatened</u> marine plants and the other creatures that live on them.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'threatened'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 통제되지 않은 인간 활동이 해양 식물을 위협했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②endangered: threatened ≈ endangered(위험에 빠뜨렸다). ❌ ①supported(지원했다): 반대. ❌ ③encouraged(격려했다): 반대. ❌ ④promoted(촉진했다): 반대.
det.tip: threatened: 위협했다. ≈ endangered, put at risk.

questions.passage: So the Korean government <u>designated</u> May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'designated'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 한국 정부가 5월 10일을 '바다식목일'로 지정했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③appointed: designated ≈ appointed(지정했다/임명했다). ❌ ①canceled(취소했다): 반대. ❌ ②rejected(거부했다): 반대. ❌ ④delayed(연기했다): 무관.
det.tip: designated: 지정했다. ≈ appointed, named, assigned.

questions.passage: Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. On a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash along the coast on this day. It is important to realize that small environmental activities we do can cause a big wave to <u>preserve</u> the sea.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'preserve'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 바다를 보존하다. 작은 환경 활동이 바다를 보존하는 큰 파도를 일으킬 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①conserve: preserve ≈ conserve(보존하다). ❌ ②destroy(파괴하다): 반대. ❌ ③exploit(착취하다): 반대. ❌ ④abandon(버리다): 반대.
det.tip: preserve: 보존하다, 보호하다. ≈ conserve, protect, maintain.

questions.passage: A lot of people may be <u>unfamiliar</u> with the fact that there are forests in the sea, but the sea has forests, too.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'unfamiliar'와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 익숙하지 않은 ↔ 잘 아는.
det.analysis: ✅ ④acquainted: unfamiliar(익숙하지 않은)의 반의어. 잘 아는. ❌ ①unknown(알려지지 않은): 동의어. ❌ ②unaware(모르는): 유사. ❌ ③strange(낯선): 유사.
det.tip: unfamiliar(익숙하지 않은) ↔ acquainted(잘 아는, 친숙한). be acquainted with = ~에 정통한.

questions.passage: Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and <u>numerous</u> marine animals live there with them. That is, sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'numerous'와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 수많은 ↔ 부족한.
det.analysis: ✅ ③scarce: numerous(수많은)의 반의어. 부족한/드문. ❌ ①abundant(풍부한): 동의어. ❌ ②countless(셀 수 없이 많은): 동의어. ❌ ④plentiful(풍부한): 동의어.
det.tip: numerous(수많은) ↔ scarce(부족한, 드문). 나머지 3개는 모두 동의어.

questions.passage:
(A) Sea forests are <u>formed</u> by marine plants, and numerous marine animals live there with them.

(B) On a smaller <u>scale</u>, groups of people pick up trash along the coast on this day.
questions.stem: (A)의 'formed'와 (B)의 'scale'의 의미를 가장 잘 나타낸 것은?

det.korean: (A) 해저 숲은 해양 식물에 의해 형성된다. (B) 더 작은 규모에서.
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 서류를 작성하다 — (B) 비늘
❌ ② (A) 형성하다 — (B) 비늘
✅ ③ (A) 형성하다 — (B) 규모
❌ ④ (A) 서류를 작성하다 — (B) 규모
✅ ③ (A) 형성하다: formed by = ~에 의해 형성됨. (B) 규모: on a smaller scale = 더 작은 규모에서.
det.tip: form: ①서류 양식 ②형성하다 ③형태. scale: ①저울 ②비늘 ③규모 ④등급.

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the natural environment in which an animal or plant usually lives"

det.korean: "동물이나 식물이 보통 사는 자연 환경" = 서식지.
det.analysis: ✅ ②habitat: 서식지. 정의와 일치. ❌ ①ecosystem(생태계): 더 넓은 개념. ❌ ③pollution(오염): 무관. ❌ ④awareness(인식): 무관.
det.tip: habitat: 서식지. 본문 'sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures'에서 등장.

questions.passage: However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants and the other creatures that live on them. So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day." It is meant to raise awareness of the seriousness of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

Everyone should be aware of the __________ (serious) of environmental issues.

det.korean: 모든 사람은 환경 문제의 심각성을 인식해야 한다.
det.analysis: ✅ seriousness: the + __________ + of → 명사 필요. serious(형용사) → seriousness(명사).
det.tip: serious(형용사: 심각한) → seriousness(명사: 심각성). -ness 접미사로 명사 전환.

questions.passage: Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. On a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash along the coast on this day. It is important to realize that small environmental activities we do can cause a big wave to preserve the sea.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

The __________ (preserve) of marine ecosystems requires global cooperation.

det.korean: 해양 생태계의 보존은 국제적 협력을 필요로 한다.
det.analysis: ✅ preservation: The + __________ + of → 명사 필요. preserve(동사) → preservation(명사).
det.tip: preserve(동사: 보존하다) → preservation(명사: 보존). -ation 접미사로 명사 전환.

questions.passage: Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and numerous marine animals live there with them. That is, sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures. However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants and the other creatures that live on them. So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world. It is meant to raise awareness of the seriousness of ocean pollution and __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: the need to build more factories near the coast
the importance of creating sea forests
the history of Korean government policies

det.korean: 해양 오염의 심각성과 해저 숲 조성의 중요성에 대한 인식을 높이기 위함.
det.analysis: ✅ ②the importance of creating sea forests: 원문 그대로. ❌ ①공장 건설: 환경 보호 맥락과 반대. ❌ ③심해 어업: 무관. ❌ ④정부 정책 역사: 무관.
det.tip: the importance of ~ = ~의 중요성. creating sea forests = 해저 숲 조성.

questions.passage: So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world. It is meant to raise awareness of the seriousness of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests. Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. On a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash along the coast on this day. It is important to realize that __________ can cause a big wave to preserve the sea.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 우리가 하는 작은 환경 활동이 바다를 보존하는 큰 파도를 일으킬 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④small environmental activities we do: 원문 그대로. 작은 활동의 큰 영향력. ❌ ①대규모 정부 프로젝트: smaller scale과 모순. ❌ ②첨단 기술: 언급 없음. ❌ ③국제 무역 협정: 무관.
det.tip: 핵심 메시지: 작은 활동(small) → 큰 변화(big wave). 개인의 실천이 중요.
